# Saranidhi (PRJ-001) — Agent Entry Map

> Curated map of the canonical, load-bearing docs for any AI agent (Operator,
> Executor, or a fresh clone) orienting on this repo. Read these FIRST; everything
> else is detail reachable from them. Adopted from the cetana-labs `llms.txt`
> convention (LAB-000). Last verified: 2026-10-14.

Saranidhi is a **local-first, zero-backend** Flutter app for Vedic time/alignment
practice (Panja Pakshi birth-bird + Sara Kalai swara/nostril clock + Prasanam Oracle).
Correctness-critical calculation engine; privacy-guaranteed; offline-capable.
Process = the **cetana-labs AIDLC family** rails (Operator plans/reviews, Executor
builds, Human is sole merge/tag authority).

## Must-read, in order

- AGENTS.md — short must-obey summary; the four load-bearing rules (ICCV, atomic
  work, verify-before-done, scope-is-a-boundary) + the non-negotiable: owner is
  sole merge/tag authority.
- .kiro/steering/collaboration-guardrails.md — PROCESS doctrine: authority (§1),
  roles & the ONE tool→role mapping (§2), correctness-critical path (§3),
  work-class routing (§3.1), pre-PR gates (§4), lifecycle protocols (§5),
  release lifecycle (§6), deploy quota + branch naming (§7–8).
- .kiro/steering/saranidhi-spec.md — CODE/architecture rules: exclusions,
  conventions, CI quality gates (2-tier + ≥19% coverage + integration),
  platform notes.
- .kiro/steering/executor-antigravity.md — the Executor contract for `/spec-run`.
- .kiro/steering/test-authoring.md — test-authoring rules.

## Product & requirements

- .kiro/product.md — product requirements.
- .kiro/structure.md — file structure.
- .kiro/design.md — architecture detail.

## Lifecycle & governance

- SPRINT_TRACKER.md — committed/in-flight work (per-feature inventory).
- BACKLOG.md — ideas (not yet committed).
- CHANGELOG.md — shipped history.
- STATUS.md — the ≤35-line portfolio-dashboard integration contract (PRJ-001).
- docs/governance/DECISION-JOURNAL.md — append-only reasoning showcase (why).
- docs/process/dev-workflow.md — the narrative dev workflow.
- docs/process/PROCESS_MIGRATION.md — the cetana-family vocabulary migration map.

## Specs

- .kiro/specs/README.md — Spec index + conventions.
- .kiro/specs/_template/ — the merge-first Kiro Spec scaffold (requirements EARS
  DoD · design · tasks · REPORT).
- .kiro/specs/golden-fixture-gate/ — the first delivered Spec (correctness gate
  reference example).

## Standing gates (never relax)

- Tamil bilingual (EN + pure Tamil script, no transliteration) on every
  user-facing string.
- CONF provenance (CONF-nn Sara Kalai / CONF-PP-nn Panja Pakshi) on every
  doctrinal rule — corpus source material in docs/research/ (sarakalai-workshop-knowledge.md,
  panja-pakshi-workshop-knowledge.md).
- Owner is SOLE merge/tag authority; agents open branches + PRs only.
- `just validate-docs` green (fails on external-repo runtime pointers —
  self-containment gate).
